_comment: Gemini->Responses contract. Pre-commit upstream failure (structurally valid but unknown shape) is a typed 502 with no fabricated terminal.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.respup]
dialect = "openai-responses"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}/v1"
api_key = "resp-secret"

[[models]]
name = "gem-resp"
provider = "respup"
model = "gpt-4.1"
name: gemini_to_responses_early_invalid_stream
